requirements.title: The character intrinsic operator concatenates same-kind character operands and produces character result type
requirements.definition: The character intrinsic operator // concatenates two operands of type character with the same kind type parameter, and evaluating the character intrinsic operation produces a result of type character.

requirements.title: Character concatenation forms the right-appended value with length equal to the sum of operand lengths
requirements.definition: Table 10.4 interprets x1 // x2 as concatenating x1 with x2. The result value is the value of x1 concatenated on the right with the value of x2, and the result length is the sum of the operand lengths. The table has a single row and its column extraction is unambiguous after row-by-row checking.

requirements.title: Parentheses specifying evaluation order do not affect the value of a character expression
requirements.source: 10.1.5.3.1 p3 final sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p178.
requirements.definition: For character expressions using the character intrinsic operation, parentheses used to specify the order of evaluation have no effect on the character expression's value.
